title: Frontend Developer Starter Kit
shortDescription: Frontend Developer Starter Kit gives learners a structured self-paced path with practical projects, checkpoints, and certificate readiness.
description:
Frontend Developer Starter Kit is built for CodeWithKasa learners who need clear lessons, practical assignments, and measurable progress. The course keeps the flow simple: learn the concept, practice it, review the output, and prepare for certification.

Projects and assessments are designed around real workflows so learners can test the platform, track completion, and build confidence.
imageAlt: Frontend Developer Starter Kit CodeWithKasa course cover photo
certificate: Certificate after recorded progress and final assessment
studyMaterial: Downloadable notes, project checklists, practice tasks, quiz prompts, and reference links.
additionalBook: Frontend Developer Starter Practice Workbook
technologyRequirements: Laptop or desktop, stable internet connection, modern browser, and VS Code where coding practice is required.
eligibilityRequirements: Basic computer comfort required. Prior coding experience is helpful but not mandatory.
disclaimer: Learner outcome depends on regular practice, project completion, attendance where applicable, and assessment performance.

title: JavaScript Mastery Self Learning Path
shortDescription: JavaScript Mastery Self Learning Path gives learners a structured self-paced path with practical projects, checkpoints, and certificate readiness.
description:
JavaScript Mastery Self Learning Path is built for CodeWithKasa learners who need clear lessons, practical assignments, and measurable progress. The course keeps the flow simple: learn the concept, practice it, review the output, and prepare for certification.

Projects and assessments are designed around real workflows so learners can test the platform, track completion, and build confidence.
imageAlt: JavaScript Mastery Self Learning Path CodeWithKasa course cover photo
certificate: Certificate after recorded progress and final assessment
studyMaterial: Downloadable notes, project checklists, practice tasks, quiz prompts, and reference links.
additionalBook: JavaScript Mastery Self Learning Practice Workbook
technologyRequirements: Laptop or desktop, stable internet connection, modern browser, and VS Code where coding practice is required.
eligibilityRequirements: No degree requirement. Learners should commit time for weekly practice and assignments.
disclaimer: Learner outcome depends on regular practice, project completion, attendance where applicable, and assessment performance.

title: TypeScript for Practical Developers
shortDescription: TypeScript for Practical Developers gives learners a structured self-paced path with practical projects, checkpoints, and certificate readiness.
description:
TypeScript for Practical Developers is built for CodeWithKasa learners who need clear lessons, practical assignments, and measurable progress. The course keeps the flow simple: learn the concept, practice it, review the output, and prepare for certification.

Projects and assessments are designed around real workflows so learners can test the platform, track completion, and build confidence.
imageAlt: TypeScript for Practical Developers CodeWithKasa course cover photo
certificate: Certificate after recorded progress and final assessment
studyMaterial: Downloadable notes, project checklists, practice tasks, quiz prompts, and reference links.
additionalBook: TypeScript for Practical Developers Practice Workbook
technologyRequirements: Laptop or desktop, stable internet connection, modern browser, and VS Code where coding practice is required.
eligibilityRequirements: No degree requirement. Learners should commit time for weekly practice and assignments.
disclaimer: Learner outcome depends on regular practice, project completion, attendance where applicable, and assessment performance.

title: React Project Builder Bootcamp
shortDescription: React Project Builder Bootcamp gives learners a structured live faculty-led path with practical projects, checkpoints, and certificate readiness.
description:
React Project Builder Bootcamp is built for CodeWithKasa learners who need clear lessons, practical assignments, and measurable progress. The course keeps the flow simple: learn the concept, practice it, review the output, and prepare for certification.

Projects and assessments are designed around real workflows so learners can test the platform, track completion, and build confidence.
imageAlt: React Project Builder Bootcamp CodeWithKasa course cover photo
certificate: Certificate after attendance, assignment review, and final assessment
studyMaterial: Downloadable notes, project checklists, practice tasks, quiz prompts, and reference links.
additionalBook: React Project Builder Practice Workbook
technologyRequirements: Laptop or desktop, stable internet connection, modern browser, and VS Code where coding practice is required.
eligibilityRequirements: No degree requirement. Learners should commit time for weekly practice and assignments.
disclaimer: Learner outcome depends on regular practice, project completion, attendance where applicable, and assessment performance.

title: Next.js Production Apps Mentorship
shortDescription: Next.js Production Apps Mentorship gives learners a structured hybrid path with practical projects, checkpoints, and certificate readiness.
description:
Next.js Production Apps Mentorship is built for CodeWithKasa learners who need clear lessons, practical assignments, and measurable progress. The course keeps the flow simple: learn the concept, practice it, review the output, and prepare for certification.

Projects and assessments are designed around real workflows so learners can test the platform, track completion, and build confidence.
imageAlt: Next.js Production Apps Mentorship CodeWithKasa course cover photo
certificate: Certificate after attendance, assignment review, and final assessment
studyMaterial: Downloadable notes, project checklists, practice tasks, quiz prompts, and reference links.
additionalBook: Next.js Production Apps Practice Workbook
technologyRequirements: Laptop or desktop, stable internet connection, modern browser, and VS Code where coding practice is required.
eligibilityRequirements: Basic computer comfort required. Prior coding experience is helpful but not mandatory.
disclaimer: Learner outcome depends on regular practice, project completion, attendance where applicable, and assessment performance.

shortDescription: Node.js API Development Live Cohort gives learners a structured live faculty-led path with practical projects, checkpoints, and certificate readiness.
description:
Node.js API Development Live Cohort is built for CodeWithKasa learners who need clear lessons, practical assignments, and measurable progress. The course keeps the flow simple: learn the concept, practice it, review the output, and prepare for certification.

Projects and assessments are designed around real workflows so learners can test the platform, track completion, and build confidence.
imageAlt: Node.js API Development Live Cohort CodeWithKasa course cover photo
certificate: Certificate after attendance, assignment review, and final assessment
studyMaterial: Downloadable notes, project checklists, practice tasks, quiz prompts, and reference links.
additionalBook: Node.js API Development  Cohort Practice Workbook
technologyRequirements: Laptop or desktop, stable internet connection, modern browser, and VS Code where coding practice is required.
eligibilityRequirements: No degree requirement. Learners should commit time for weekly practice and assignments.
disclaimer: Learner outcome depends on regular practice, project completion, attendance where applicable, and assessment performance.

title: NestJS Backend Architecture Program
shortDescription: NestJS Backend Architecture Program gives learners a structured live faculty-led path with practical projects, checkpoints, and certificate readiness.
description:
NestJS Backend Architecture Program is built for CodeWithKasa learners who need clear lessons, practical assignments, and measurable progress. The course keeps the flow simple: learn the concept, practice it, review the output, and prepare for certification.

Projects and assessments are designed around real workflows so learners can test the platform, track completion, and build confidence.
imageAlt: NestJS Backend Architecture Program CodeWithKasa course cover photo
certificate: Certificate after attendance, assignment review, and final assessment
studyMaterial: Downloadable notes, project checklists, practice tasks, quiz prompts, and reference links.
additionalBook: NestJS Backend Architecture Practice Workbook
technologyRequirements: Laptop or desktop, stable internet connection, modern browser, and VS Code where coding practice is required.
eligibilityRequirements: No degree requirement. Learners should commit time for weekly practice and assignments.
disclaimer: Learner outcome depends on regular practice, project completion, attendance where applicable, and assessment performance.

title: PostgreSQL and Database Design
shortDescription: PostgreSQL and Database Design gives learners a structured self-paced path with practical projects, checkpoints, and certificate readiness.
description:
PostgreSQL and Database Design is built for CodeWithKasa learners who need clear lessons, practical assignments, and measurable progress. The course keeps the flow simple: learn the concept, practice it, review the output, and prepare for certification.

Projects and assessments are designed around real workflows so learners can test the platform, track completion, and build confidence.
imageAlt: PostgreSQL and Database Design CodeWithKasa course cover photo
certificate: Certificate after recorded progress and final assessment
studyMaterial: Downloadable notes, project checklists, practice tasks, quiz prompts, and reference links.
additionalBook: PostgreSQL and Database Design Practice Workbook
technologyRequirements: Laptop or desktop, stable internet connection, modern browser, and VS Code where coding practice is required.
eligibilityRequirements: No degree requirement. Learners should commit time for weekly practice and assignments.
disclaimer: Learner outcome depends on regular practice, project completion, attendance where applicable, and assessment performance.

title: Full Stack Web Development Mentorship
shortDescription: Full Stack Web Development Mentorship gives learners a structured hybrid path with practical projects, checkpoints, and certificate readiness.
description:
Full Stack Web Development Mentorship is built for CodeWithKasa learners who need clear lessons, practical assignments, and measurable progress. The course keeps the flow simple: learn the concept, practice it, review the output, and prepare for certification.

Projects and assessments are designed around real workflows so learners can test the platform, track completion, and build confidence.
imageAlt: Full Stack Web Development Mentorship CodeWithKasa course cover photo
certificate: Certificate after attendance, assignment review, and final assessment
studyMaterial: Downloadable notes, project checklists, practice tasks, quiz prompts, and reference links.
additionalBook: Full Stack Web Development Practice Workbook
technologyRequirements: Laptop or desktop, stable internet connection, modern browser, and VS Code where coding practice is required.
eligibilityRequirements: Basic computer comfort required. Prior coding experience is helpful but not mandatory.

title: Python Programming Foundations
shortDescription: Python Programming Foundations gives learners a structured self-paced path with practical projects, checkpoints, and certificate readiness.
description:
Python Programming Foundations is built for CodeWithKasa learners who need clear lessons, practical assignments, and measurable progress. The course keeps the flow simple: learn the concept, practice it, review the output, and prepare for certification.

Projects and assessments are designed around real workflows so learners can test the platform, track completion, and build confidence.
imageAlt: Python Programming Foundations CodeWithKasa course cover photo
certificate: Certificate after recorded progress and final assessment
studyMaterial: Downloadable notes, project checklists, practice tasks, quiz prompts, and reference links.
additionalBook: Python ming Foundations Practice Workbook
technologyRequirements: Laptop or desktop, stable internet connection, modern browser, and VS Code where coding practice is required.
eligibilityRequirements: No degree requirement. Learners should commit time for weekly practice and assignments.
disclaimer: Learner outcome depends on regular practice, project completion, attendance where applicable, and assessment performance.

title: Data Analytics Career Track
shortDescription: Data Analytics Career Track gives learners a structured hybrid path with practical projects, checkpoints, and certificate readiness.
description:
Data Analytics Career Track is built for CodeWithKasa learners who need clear lessons, practical assignments, and measurable progress. The course keeps the flow simple: learn the concept, practice it, review the output, and prepare for certification.

Projects and assessments are designed around real workflows so learners can test the platform, track completion, and build confidence.
imageAlt: Data Analytics Career Track CodeWithKasa course cover photo
certificate: Certificate after attendance, assignment review, and final assessment
studyMaterial: Downloadable notes, project checklists, practice tasks, quiz prompts, and reference links.
additionalBook: Data Analytics Career Practice Workbook
technologyRequirements: Laptop or desktop, stable internet connection, modern browser, and VS Code where coding practice is required.
eligibilityRequirements: No degree requirement. Learners should commit time for weekly practice and assignments.
disclaimer: Learner outcome depends on regular practice, project completion, attendance where applicable, and assessment performance.

Excel SQL and Dashboard Reporting is built for CodeWithKasa learners who need clear lessons, practical assignments, and measurable progress. The course keeps the flow simple: learn the concept, practice it, review the output, and prepare for certification.

Projects and assessments are designed around real workflows so learners can test the platform, track completion, and build confidence.

title: DSA Interview Practice Live
shortDescription: DSA Interview Practice Live gives learners a structured live faculty-led path with practical projects, checkpoints, and certificate readiness.
description:
DSA Interview Practice Live is built for CodeWithKasa learners who need clear lessons, practical assignments, and measurable progress. The course keeps the flow simple: learn the concept, practice it, review the output, and prepare for certification.

Projects and assessments are designed around real workflows so learners can test the platform, track completion, and build confidence.
imageAlt: DSA Interview Practice Live CodeWithKasa course cover photo
certificate: Certificate after attendance, assignment review, and final assessment
studyMaterial: Downloadable notes, project checklists, practice tasks, quiz prompts, and reference links.
additionalBook: DSA Interview Practice Practice Workbook
technologyRequirements: Laptop or desktop, stable internet connection, modern browser, and VS Code where coding practice is required.
eligibilityRequirements: Basic computer comfort required. Prior coding experience is helpful but not mandatory.
disclaimer: Learner outcome depends on regular practice, project completion, attendance where applicable, and assessment performance.

title: Git and GitHub Team Workflow
shortDescription: Git and GitHub Team Workflow gives learners a structured self-paced path with practical projects, checkpoints, and certificate readiness.
description:
Git and GitHub Team Workflow is built for CodeWithKasa learners who need clear lessons, practical assignments, and measurable progress. The course keeps the flow simple: learn the concept, practice it, review the output, and prepare for certification.

Projects and assessments are designed around real workflows so learners can test the platform, track completion, and build confidence.
imageAlt: Git and GitHub Team Workflow CodeWithKasa course cover photo
certificate: Certificate after recorded progress and final assessment
studyMaterial: Downloadable notes, project checklists, practice tasks, quiz prompts, and reference links.
additionalBook: Git and GitHub Team Workflow Practice Workbook
technologyRequirements: Laptop or desktop, stable internet connection, modern browser, and VS Code where coding practice is required.
eligibilityRequirements: No degree requirement. Learners should commit time for weekly practice and assignments.
disclaimer: Learner outcome depends on regular practice, project completion, attendance where applicable, and assessment performance.

title: Docker DevOps Starter Course
shortDescription: Docker DevOps Starter Course gives learners a structured self-paced path with practical projects, checkpoints, and certificate readiness.
description:
Docker DevOps Starter Course is built for CodeWithKasa learners who need clear lessons, practical assignments, and measurable progress. The course keeps the flow simple: learn the concept, practice it, review the output, and prepare for certification.

Projects and assessments are designed around real workflows so learners can test the platform, track completion, and build confidence.
imageAlt: Docker DevOps Starter Course CodeWithKasa course cover photo
certificate: Certificate after recorded progress and final assessment
studyMaterial: Downloadable notes, project checklists, practice tasks, quiz prompts, and reference links.
additionalBook: Docker DevOps Starter Practice Workbook
technologyRequirements: Laptop or desktop, stable internet connection, modern browser, and VS Code where coding practice is required.
eligibilityRequirements: No degree requirement. Learners should commit time for weekly practice and assignments.
disclaimer: Learner outcome depends on regular practice, project completion, attendance where applicable, and assessment performance.

title: AWS Cloud Deployment Essentials
shortDescription: AWS Cloud Deployment Essentials gives learners a structured live faculty-led path with practical projects, checkpoints, and certificate readiness.
description:
AWS Cloud Deployment Essentials is built for CodeWithKasa learners who need clear lessons, practical assignments, and measurable progress. The course keeps the flow simple: learn the concept, practice it, review the output, and prepare for certification.

Projects and assessments are designed around real workflows so learners can test the platform, track completion, and build confidence.
imageAlt: AWS Cloud Deployment Essentials CodeWithKasa course cover photo
certificate: Certificate after attendance, assignment review, and final assessment
studyMaterial: Downloadable notes, project checklists, practice tasks, quiz prompts, and reference links.
additionalBook: AWS Cloud Deployment Essentials Practice Workbook
technologyRequirements: Laptop or desktop, stable internet connection, modern browser, and VS Code where coding practice is required.
eligibilityRequirements: No degree requirement. Learners should commit time for weekly practice and assignments.
disclaimer: Learner outcome depends on regular practice, project completion, attendance where applicable, and assessment performance.

title: Web Performance Optimization Lab
shortDescription: Web Performance Optimization Lab gives learners a structured live faculty-led path with practical projects, checkpoints, and certificate readiness.
description:
Web Performance Optimization Lab is built for CodeWithKasa learners who need clear lessons, practical assignments, and measurable progress. The course keeps the flow simple: learn the concept, practice it, review the output, and prepare for certification.

Projects and assessments are designed around real workflows so learners can test the platform, track completion, and build confidence.
imageAlt: Web Performance Optimization Lab CodeWithKasa course cover photo
certificate: Certificate after attendance, assignment review, and final assessment
studyMaterial: Downloadable notes, project checklists, practice tasks, quiz prompts, and reference links.
additionalBook: Web Performance Optimization Practice Workbook
technologyRequirements: Laptop or desktop, stable internet connection, modern browser, and VS Code where coding practice is required.
eligibilityRequirements: Basic computer comfort required. Prior coding experience is helpful but not mandatory.
disclaimer: Learner outcome depends on regular practice, project completion, attendance where applicable, and assessment performance.

title: UI UX Design Essentials
shortDescription: UI UX Design Essentials gives learners a structured self-paced path with practical projects, checkpoints, and certificate readiness.
description:
UI UX Design Essentials is built for CodeWithKasa learners who need clear lessons, practical assignments, and measurable progress. The course keeps the flow simple: learn the concept, practice it, review the output, and prepare for certification.

Projects and assessments are designed around real workflows so learners can test the platform, track completion, and build confidence.
imageAlt: UI UX Design Essentials CodeWithKasa course cover photo
certificate: Certificate after recorded progress and final assessment
studyMaterial: Downloadable notes, project checklists, practice tasks, quiz prompts, and reference links.

title: Figma to Frontend Workflow
shortDescription: Figma to Frontend Workflow gives learners a structured hybrid path with practical projects, checkpoints, and certificate readiness.
description:
Figma to Frontend Workflow is built for CodeWithKasa learners who need clear lessons, practical assignments, and measurable progress. The course keeps the flow simple: learn the concept, practice it, review the output, and prepare for certification.

Projects and assessments are designed around real workflows so learners can test the platform, track completion, and build confidence.
imageAlt: Figma to Frontend Workflow CodeWithKasa course cover photo
certificate: Certificate after attendance, assignment review, and final assessment
studyMaterial: Downloadable notes, project checklists, practice tasks, quiz prompts, and reference links.
additionalBook: Figma to Frontend Workflow Practice Workbook
technologyRequirements: Laptop or desktop, stable internet connection, modern browser, and VS Code where coding practice is required.
eligibilityRequirements: No degree requirement. Learners should commit time for weekly practice and assignments.
disclaimer: Learner outcome depends on regular practice, project completion, attendance where applicable, and assessment performance.

title: QA Automation with Playwright
shortDescription: QA Automation with Playwright gives learners a structured live faculty-led path with practical projects, checkpoints, and certificate readiness.
description:
QA Automation with Playwright is built for CodeWithKasa learners who need clear lessons, practical assignments, and measurable progress. The course keeps the flow simple: learn the concept, practice it, review the output, and prepare for certification.

Projects and assessments are designed around real workflows so learners can test the platform, track completion, and build confidence.
imageAlt: QA Automation with Playwright CodeWithKasa course cover photo
certificate: Certificate after attendance, assignment review, and final assessment
studyMaterial: Downloadable notes, project checklists, practice tasks, quiz prompts, and reference links.
additionalBook: QA Automation with Playwright Practice Workbook
technologyRequirements: Laptop or desktop, stable internet connection, modern browser, and VS Code where coding practice is required.
eligibilityRequirements: No degree requirement. Learners should commit time for weekly practice and assignments.
disclaimer: Learner outcome depends on regular practice, project completion, attendance where applicable, and assessment performance.

title: Cybersecurity for Web Developers
shortDescription: Cybersecurity for Web Developers gives learners a structured self-paced path with practical projects, checkpoints, and certificate readiness.
description:
Cybersecurity for Web Developers is built for CodeWithKasa learners who need clear lessons, practical assignments, and measurable progress. The course keeps the flow simple: learn the concept, practice it, review the output, and prepare for certification.

Projects and assessments are designed around real workflows so learners can test the platform, track completion, and build confidence.
imageAlt: Cybersecurity for Web Developers CodeWithKasa course cover photo
certificate: Certificate after recorded progress and final assessment
studyMaterial: Downloadable notes, project checklists, practice tasks, quiz prompts, and reference links.
additionalBook: Cybersecurity for Web Developers Practice Workbook
technologyRequirements: Laptop or desktop, stable internet connection, modern browser, and VS Code where coding practice is required.
eligibilityRequirements: Basic computer comfort required. Prior coding experience is helpful but not mandatory.
disclaimer: Learner outcome depends on regular practice, project completion, attendance where applicable, and assessment performance.

description:
React Native App Launchpad is built for CodeWithKasa learners who need clear lessons, practical assignments, and measurable progress. The course keeps the flow simple: learn the concept, practice it, review the output, and prepare for certification.

Projects and assessments are designed around real workflows so learners can test the platform, track completion, and build confidence.

certificate: Certificate after attendance, assignment review, and final assessment
studyMaterial: Downloadable notes, project checklists, practice tasks, quiz prompts, and reference links.
additionalBook: React Native App Launchpad Practice Workbook
technologyRequirements: Laptop or desktop, stable internet connection, modern browser, and VS Code where coding practice is required.
eligibilityRequirements: No degree requirement. Learners should commit time for weekly practice and assignments.
disclaimer: Learner outcome depends on regular practice, project completion, attendance where applicable, and assessment performance.

title: AI Tools for Developer Productivity
shortDescription: AI Tools for Developer Productivity gives learners a structured self-paced path with practical projects, checkpoints, and certificate readiness.
description:
AI Tools for Developer Productivity is built for CodeWithKasa learners who need clear lessons, practical assignments, and measurable progress. The course keeps the flow simple: learn the concept, practice it, review the output, and prepare for certification.

Projects and assessments are designed around real workflows so learners can test the platform, track completion, and build confidence.
imageAlt: AI Tools for Developer Productivity CodeWithKasa course cover photo
certificate: Certificate after recorded progress and final assessment
studyMaterial: Downloadable notes, project checklists, practice tasks, quiz prompts, and reference links.
additionalBook: AI Tools for Developer Productivity Practice Workbook
technologyRequirements: Laptop or desktop, stable internet connection, modern browser, and VS Code where coding practice is required.
eligibilityRequirements: No degree requirement. Learners should commit time for weekly practice and assignments.
disclaimer: Learner outcome depends on regular practice, project completion, attendance where applicable, and assessment performance.

title: Technical Writing for Developers
shortDescription: Technical Writing for Developers gives learners a structured self-paced path with practical projects, checkpoints, and certificate readiness.
description:
Technical Writing for Developers is built for CodeWithKasa learners who need clear lessons, practical assignments, and measurable progress. The course keeps the flow simple: learn the concept, practice it, review the output, and prepare for certification.

Projects and assessments are designed around real workflows so learners can test the platform, track completion, and build confidence.
imageAlt: Technical Writing for Developers CodeWithKasa course cover photo
certificate: Certificate after recorded progress and final assessment
studyMaterial: Downloadable notes, project checklists, practice tasks, quiz prompts, and reference links.
additionalBook: Technical Writing for Developers Practice Workbook
technologyRequirements: Laptop or desktop, stable internet connection, modern browser, and VS Code where coding practice is required.
eligibilityRequirements: No degree requirement. Learners should commit time for weekly practice and assignments.
disclaimer: Learner outcome depends on regular practice, project completion, attendance where applicable, and assessment performance.

title: Spoken English Live Confidence Batch
shortDescription: Spoken English Live Confidence Batch gives learners a structured live faculty-led path with practical projects, checkpoints, and certificate readiness.
description:
Spoken English Live Confidence Batch is built for CodeWithKasa learners who need clear lessons, practical assignments, and measurable progress. The course keeps the flow simple: learn the concept, practice it, review the output, and prepare for certification.

Projects and assessments are designed around real workflows so learners can test the platform, track completion, and build confidence.
imageAlt: Spoken English Live Confidence Batch CodeWithKasa course cover photo
certificate: Certificate after attendance, assignment review, and final assessment
studyMaterial: Downloadable notes, project checklists, practice tasks, quiz prompts, and reference links.
additionalBook: Spoken English  Confidence Practice Workbook
technologyRequirements: Laptop or desktop, stable internet connection, modern browser, and VS Code where coding practice is required.
eligibilityRequirements: Basic computer comfort required. Prior coding experience is helpful but not mandatory.
disclaimer: Learner outcome depends on regular practice, project completion, attendance where applicable, and assessment performance.

title: Career Prep Resume and Interview Lab
shortDescription: Career Prep Resume and Interview Lab gives learners a structured live faculty-led path with practical projects, checkpoints, and certificate readiness.
description:
Career Prep Resume and Interview Lab is built for CodeWithKasa learners who need clear lessons, practical assignments, and measurable progress. The course keeps the flow simple: learn the concept, practice it, review the output, and prepare for certification.

Projects and assessments are designed around real workflows so learners can test the platform, track completion, and build confidence.
imageAlt: Career Prep Resume and Interview Lab CodeWithKasa course cover photo
certificate: Certificate after attendance, assignment review, and final assessment
studyMaterial: Downloadable notes, project checklists, practice tasks, quiz prompts, and reference links.
additionalBook: Career Prep Resume and Interview Practice Workbook
technologyRequirements: Laptop or desktop, stable internet connection, modern browser, and VS Code where coding practice is required.
eligibilityRequirements: No degree requirement. Learners should commit time for weekly practice and assignments.
disclaimer: Learner outcome depends on regular practice, project completion, attendance where applicable, and assessment performance.

title: System Design Foundation Hybrid
shortDescription: System Design Foundation Hybrid gives learners a structured hybrid path with practical projects, checkpoints, and certificate readiness.
description:
System Design Foundation Hybrid is built for CodeWithKasa learners who need clear lessons, practical assignments, and measurable progress. The course keeps the flow simple: learn the concept, practice it, review the output, and prepare for certification.

Projects and assessments are designed around real workflows so learners can test the platform, track completion, and build confidence.
imageAlt: System Design Foundation Hybrid CodeWithKasa course cover photo
certificate: Certificate after attendance, assignment review, and final assessment
studyMaterial: Downloadable notes, project checklists, practice tasks, quiz prompts, and reference links.
additionalBook: System Design Foundation Practice Workbook
technologyRequirements: Laptop or desktop, stable internet connection, modern browser, and VS Code where coding practice is required.
eligibilityRequirements: No degree requirement. Learners should commit time for weekly practice and assignments.
disclaimer: Learner outcome depends on regular practice, project completion, attendance where applicable, and assessment performance.

title: Ecommerce Website Builder Program
shortDescription: Ecommerce Website Builder Program gives learners a structured live faculty-led path with practical projects, checkpoints, and certificate readiness.
description:
Ecommerce Website Builder Program is built for CodeWithKasa learners who need clear lessons, practical assignments, and measurable progress. The course keeps the flow simple: learn the concept, practice it, review the output, and prepare for certification.

Projects and assessments are designed around real workflows so learners can test the platform, track completion, and build confidence.
imageAlt: Ecommerce Website Builder Program CodeWithKasa course cover photo
certificate: Certificate after attendance, assignment review, and final assessment
studyMaterial: Downloadable notes, project checklists, practice tasks, quiz prompts, and reference links.
additionalBook: Ecommerce Website Builder Practice Workbook
technologyRequirements: Laptop or desktop, stable internet connection, modern browser, and VS Code where coding practice is required.
eligibilityRequirements: No degree requirement. Learners should commit time for weekly practice and assignments.
disclaimer: Learner outcome depends on regular practice, project completion, attendance where applicable, and assessment performance.

title: Freelance Developer Business Kit
shortDescription: Freelance Developer Business Kit gives learners a structured self-paced path with practical projects, checkpoints, and certificate readiness.
description:
Freelance Developer Business Kit is built for CodeWithKasa learners who need clear lessons, practical assignments, and measurable progress. The course keeps the flow simple: learn the concept, practice it, review the output, and prepare for certification.

Projects and assessments are designed around real workflows so learners can test the platform, track completion, and build confidence.
imageAlt: Freelance Developer Business Kit CodeWithKasa course cover photo
certificate: Certificate after recorded progress and final assessment
studyMaterial: Downloadable notes, project checklists, practice tasks, quiz prompts, and reference links.
additionalBook: Freelance Developer Business Practice Workbook
technologyRequirements: Laptop or desktop, stable internet connection, modern browser, and VS Code where coding practice is required.
eligibilityRequirements: Basic computer comfort required. Prior coding experience is helpful but not mandatory.
disclaimer: Learner outcome depends on regular practice, project completion, attendance where applicable, and assessment performance.

title: Product Analytics and Growth Metrics
shortDescription: Product Analytics and Growth Metrics gives learners a structured hybrid path with practical projects, checkpoints, and certificate readiness.
description:
Product Analytics and Growth Metrics is built for CodeWithKasa learners who need clear lessons, practical assignments, and measurable progress. The course keeps the flow simple: learn the concept, practice it, review the output, and prepare for certification.

Projects and assessments are designed around real workflows so learners can test the platform, track completion, and build confidence.
imageAlt: Product Analytics and Growth Metrics CodeWithKasa course cover photo
certificate: Certificate after attendance, assignment review, and final assessment
studyMaterial: Downloadable notes, project checklists, practice tasks, quiz prompts, and reference links.
additionalBook: Product Analytics and Growth Metrics Practice Workbook
technologyRequirements: Laptop or desktop, stable internet connection, modern browser, and VS Code where coding practice is required.
eligibilityRequirements: No degree requirement. Learners should commit time for weekly practice and assignments.
disclaimer: Learner outcome depends on regular practice, project completion, attendance where applicable, and assessment performance.
